name: combat-3: Magic adds max mana (+0.5% a Magic level, every hero)
why: 52-review-combat M2. Since Mend became a share of max HP (32-4) the Magic skill has no consumer on a weapon hero. This gives it one: max mana grows 0.5% a Magic level. The real change is one coefficient in VITALS; the edit here plays it in the engine's vitals. It targets gold (drinks bought) and survival. The review's worry is that it widens the wand's lead.
